## Purpose

Describe which genes are mutated or deleted in the cell lines with
metabolomics data, how alterations distribute over tissues, and which
alterations co-occur or exclude each other. This is the basis for choosing a
mutation-based contrast (analysis/03).

## Inputs

- `data/derived/cancer-cell-lines/shorthouse_v1/shorthouse_analysis_v1.rds` (lines used in models, DepMap mutation and copy-number status)
- `data/raw/cancer-cell-lines/msb202211006-sup-0005-datasetev4.xlsx` (genes tested by Shorthouse et al.)
- `config.yml`: `landscape` parameters

## Methods

All cell lines used in mutation models were included (malignant, with tissue
label and DepMap data; n given below). Genes were restricted to the 658 genes
tested by Shorthouse et al. (Dataset EV4, derived from the COSMIC Cancer Gene
Census) plus MTAP. Mutation status came from DepMap 24Q4: any protein-changing
somatic variant, and likely-driver variants (hotspot, likely loss of function,
Hess driver, or high impact in an oncogene or tumour suppressor, as flagged by
DepMap). Homozygous deletion was defined as absolute copy number 0; lines
without copy number count as not deleted here. The contrasts leave these lines
out for MTAP, whose status rests on copy number alone (D25). For the tests below, a gene was
considered altered if it carried a likely-driver mutation or a homozygous
deletion (provisional definition, see open question Q1). Tissue specificity
was tested per gene and tissue with Fisher's exact test (lines of the tissue
vs all other lines). Co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity between genes were
tested with the Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test stratified by tissue, so that
shared tissue frequencies do not appear as co-occurrence; the common odds ratio
gives the direction (> 1 co-occurrence, < 1 mutual exclusivity). p-values were
adjusted with the Benjamini–Hochberg procedure within each analysis. Only
genes altered in at least `min_altered_lines` lines were tested.

```{r setup, message = FALSE}
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)

source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/use_case.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/plotting.R"))
source(here::here("analyses/cancer-cell-lines/R/mutations.R"))
config <- load_config()
derived_dir <- uc_dir(config, "derived")
raw_dir <- uc_dir(config, "raw")
output_dir <- uc_dir(config, "output", "02_mutation_landscape")
params <- config$landscape

data <- readRDS(file.path(derived_dir, "shorthouse_analysis_v1.rds"))
lines <- filter(data$lines, in_models)

# genes tested by Shorthouse et al. (EV4 columns "T_<gene>") plus MTAP
ev4 <- readxl::read_excel(file.path(raw_dir, "msb202211006-sup-0005-datasetev4.xlsx"), sheet = "Sheet1", n_max = 1)
genes <- union(sub("^T_", "", setdiff(names(ev4), "ionIdx")), "MTAP")
c(lines = nrow(lines), with_copy_number = sum(lines$has_copy_number), genes = length(genes))
count(lines, tissue, sort = TRUE)
```

## Alteration status

```{r status}
# one row per line and gene with mutation (any / likely driver) and deletion
# status (alteration_status() in R/mutations.R)
status <- alteration_status(data, lines$line, genes) %>%
    # provisional definition used in the tests (open question Q1)
    mutate(altered = likely_driver | deleted)

preview_table(filter(status, any_mutation | deleted), caption = "Altered line–gene pairs")
```

## 1. Frequencies

```{r frequencies}
frequencies <- status %>%
    group_by(gene) %>%
    summarise(
        any_mutation = sum(any_mutation),
        likely_driver = sum(likely_driver),
        deleted = sum(deleted),
        altered = sum(altered),
        .groups = "drop"
    ) %>%
    arrange(desc(altered))
preview_table(frequencies, caption = sprintf("Lines per gene (%d lines)", nrow(lines)))

top_genes <- head(frequencies$gene, params$n_top_genes)
p <- frequencies %>%
    filter(gene %in% top_genes) %>%
    pivot_longer(c(any_mutation, likely_driver, deleted), names_to = "definition", values_to = "lines") %>%
    mutate(definition = factor(definition, levels = c("any_mutation", "likely_driver", "deleted"),
                               labels = c("any protein-changing", "likely driver", "homozygous deletion"))) %>%
    ggplot(aes(lines, factor(gene, levels = rev(top_genes)), fill = definition)) +
    geom_col(position = "dodge") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("#0072B2", "#D55E00", "#009E73")) +
    labs(x = "Cell lines", y = NULL, fill = NULL,
         title = sprintf("Most frequently altered genes (%d lines)", nrow(lines))) +
    theme_uc() +
    theme(legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p, "frequencies_top_genes", output_dir, width = 8, height = 8)
p
```

Oncoprint-style overview: lines (columns) grouped by tissue, genes (rows)
ordered by frequency.

```{r oncoprint, fig.width = 14, fig.height = 8}
oncoprint <- status %>%
    filter(gene %in% top_genes) %>%
    mutate(alteration = case_when(
        likely_driver & deleted ~ "likely driver + deletion",
        likely_driver ~ "likely driver",
        deleted ~ "homozygous deletion",
        any_mutation ~ "other protein-changing",
        TRUE ~ NA_character_
    ))
# order lines by tissue, then by number of altered top genes
line_order <- oncoprint %>%
    group_by(line, tissue) %>%
    summarise(n = sum(!is.na(alteration)), .groups = "drop") %>%
    arrange(tissue, desc(n)) %>%
    pull(line)
p <- oncoprint %>%
    filter(!is.na(alteration)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(factor(line, levels = line_order), factor(gene, levels = rev(top_genes)), fill = alteration)) +
    geom_tile() +
    facet_grid(~ tissue, scales = "free_x", space = "free_x") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c("likely driver" = "#D55E00", "homozygous deletion" = "#0072B2",
                                 "likely driver + deletion" = "#CC79A7", "other protein-changing" = "grey70")) +
    labs(x = "Cell lines", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Alterations of the most frequently altered genes by tissue") +
    theme_uc() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_blank(), axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
          panel.spacing = grid::unit(1, "pt"), strip.text = element_text(angle = 90, size = 8),
          legend.position = "bottom")
save_figure(p, "oncoprint", output_dir, width = 14, height = 8)
p
```

## 2. Tissue specificity

```{r tissue-specificity}
tested_genes <- frequencies$gene[frequencies$altered >= params$min_altered_lines]
length(tested_genes)

# Fisher's exact test per gene and tissue: altered in this tissue vs in all other lines
tissue_tests <- expand_grid(gene = tested_genes, tissue = sort(unique(lines$tissue))) %>%
    rowwise() %>%
    mutate(test = list({
        s <- status[status$gene == gene, ]
        tab <- table(factor(s$tissue == tissue, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)),
                     factor(s$altered, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)))
        ft <- fisher.test(tab)
        tibble(altered_in_tissue = tab[1, 1], lines_in_tissue = sum(tab[1, ]),
               altered_elsewhere = tab[2, 1], lines_elsewhere = sum(tab[2, ]),
               odds_ratio = unname(ft$estimate), p = ft$p.value)
    })) %>%
    ungroup() %>%
    unnest(test) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"))

tissue_tests %>% arrange(p) %>% preview_table(caption = "Tissue specificity (Fisher, BH over all gene × tissue tests)")

p <- tissue_tests %>%
    mutate(share = altered_in_tissue / lines_in_tissue,
           significant = p_adj < 0.05) %>%
    ggplot(aes(tissue, factor(gene, levels = rev(tested_genes)), fill = share)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(significant, "*", "")), size = 5, vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient(low = "#F7FBFF", high = "#08519C", labels = scales::percent) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "Lines altered",
         title = "Share of altered lines per tissue",
         subtitle = "* tissue differs from all other lines (Fisher, BH < 0.05)") +
    theme_uc() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_figure(p, "tissue_specificity", output_dir, width = 8, height = 7)
p
```

## 3. Co-occurrence and mutual exclusivity (tissue-adjusted)

```{r cooccurrence}
# Cochran–Mantel–Haenszel test per gene pair, stratified by tissue
gene_pairs <- t(combn(tested_genes, 2))
cmh_test <- function(g1, g2) {
    a <- status %>% filter(gene == g1) %>% select(line, tissue, a = altered)
    b <- status %>% filter(gene == g2) %>% select(line, b = altered)
    d <- inner_join(a, b, by = "line")
    tab <- table(factor(d$a, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)), factor(d$b, levels = c(TRUE, FALSE)), d$tissue)
    # strata with fewer than two lines carry no information
    tab <- tab[, , apply(tab, 3, sum) > 1, drop = FALSE]
    result <- tryCatch(mantelhaen.test(tab), error = function(e) NULL)
    tibble(gene_1 = g1, gene_2 = g2, both_altered = sum(d$a & d$b),
           common_odds_ratio = if (is.null(result)) NA_real_ else unname(result$estimate),
           p = if (is.null(result)) NA_real_ else result$p.value)
}
cooccurrence <- bind_rows(lapply(seq_len(nrow(gene_pairs)), function(i) cmh_test(gene_pairs[i, 1], gene_pairs[i, 2]))) %>%
    mutate(p_adj = p.adjust(p, "BH"),
           relation = case_when(p_adj < 0.05 & common_odds_ratio > 1 ~ "co-occurring",
                                p_adj < 0.05 & common_odds_ratio < 1 ~ "mutually exclusive",
                                TRUE ~ "not significant"))
count(cooccurrence, relation)
cooccurrence %>% arrange(p) %>% preview_table(caption = "Gene pairs (CMH stratified by tissue, BH)")

p <- cooccurrence %>%
    mutate(log2_or = pmax(pmin(log2(common_odds_ratio), 4), -4)) %>%
    ggplot(aes(factor(gene_1, levels = tested_genes), factor(gene_2, levels = rev(tested_genes)), fill = log2_or)) +
    geom_tile(colour = "white") +
    geom_text(aes(label = ifelse(p_adj < 0.05, "*", "")), vjust = 0.75) +
    scale_fill_gradient2(low = "#0072B2", mid = "white", high = "#D55E00", midpoint = 0, na.value = "grey90",
                         limits = c(-4, 4)) +
    labs(x = NULL, y = NULL, fill = "log2 common\nodds ratio",
         title = "Co-occurrence (red) and mutual exclusivity (blue), adjusted for tissue",
         subtitle = "* BH < 0.05; grey: not estimable") +
    theme_uc() +
    theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
save_figure(p, "cooccurrence", output_dir, width = 9, height = 8)
p
```

## Interpretation

- **Frequencies:** TP53 is altered in most lines (130 of 167), followed by
  CDKN2A (76, mostly homozygous deletions), KRAS (42) and MTAP (34, deletions
  only). STK11, ARID1A, RB1, SMARCA4, PTEN, PIK3CA, BRAF, SMAD4 and NRAS are
  altered in 11 to 22 lines each. 27 genes reach the threshold for testing.
- **Tissue specificity** reproduces known biology: BRAF in skin (melanoma),
  APC in colon, KRAS and SMAD4 in pancreas, TERT in bladder and brain, STK11 in
  lung, and fewer TP53 alterations in kidney. This supports the consistency of
  the mutation annotation and the tissue labels, and shows that several genes
  can only be contrasted within one or two tissues.
- **Co-occurrence:** after adjusting for tissue, only CDKN2A and MTAP co-occur
  significantly, as expected for their joint deletion at 9p21. No pair is
  significantly mutually exclusive at this sample size; the relations to watch
  in the contrast selection have to be checked per contrast (e.g. within lung).
- **Caution:** genes such as MUC16, LRP1B and CSMD3 count as likely-driver
  altered because DepMap flags any likely loss-of-function variant; in very
  long genes these are often passenger events. The definition of "altered"
  (open question Q1) matters for these genes.
